legitimateSessionExceptions.evidenceSummary: DCCC remained in the temporary-listing/IPO-preparation path in March 2026, with trading to begin only after the offering/start-of-trading process. The temporary-listing rule expressly prohibits ordinary dealing before trading starts except with regulator approval. Current market-data surfaces do not expose a 2026-09-17 traded session for DCCC; Arab Finance shows market NOPL/zero trading statistics and StockAnalysis' latest actual close predates the target session. No prior OHLCV is carried forward and no synthetic zero-volume bar is created.

DEIN / ISIN EGS63031C016 is explicitly shown by MarketScreener as an end-of-day Egyptian Exchange quote for 2026-09-17 at 10.35 with 0.00% change. StockAnalysis/S&P reports At close Sep 17, 2026 but its daily history has no Sep-17 traded row and shows blank volume on the intervening unchanged sessions after the Sep-10 trade of 4 shares. Investing independently displays Sep-17 as a closed daily row with blank Volume. This is a no-trade exception only; no Sep-17 OHLCV is synthesized or carried forward.
